ev.q: During 2015–2016, 3.5% of adult visits to the ED were made by those with chronic kidney disease.
A higher percentage of visits were made by men with chronic kidney disease than women (4.1% compared with 2.7%).
During 2015–2016, 3.5% of adult visits to the ED were made by those with chronic kidney disease.
A higher percentage of visits were made by men with chronic kidney disease than women (4.1% compared with 2.7%).
The same pattern was observed for non-Hispanic black men (5.0%) and women (2.4%).
Based on a sample of visits to EDs in noninstitutional general and short-stay hospitals

methods_quotes.q: With 95% confidence intervals indicated with error bars.
